function: CNN predicts mmWave beamspace from sub-6G channel estimate; multi-layer GNN selects analog beams for multi-user hybrid beamforming; digital LMMSE precoder is not learned (pp. 5-8).
system: Dual-band downlink: BS 64 mmWave antennas (28 GHz, hybrid), UEs 8 antennas; sub-6G 3.5 GHz, 16 BS and 4 UE antennas; no RIS (pp. 3, 9).
method: 2D CNN for beamspace prediction (supervised, NMSE loss), then 3-layer GNN with 2D-CNN graph convolution for analog beam selection (unsupervised, spectral-efficiency surrogate loss); two-step training (pp. 5-9).
data_channel: DeepMIMO O1 ray tracing at 3.5 and 28 GHz; 200,000 channel samples and 24,000 multi-user samples from Region 1, split 0.4:0.1:0.5 (pp. 9-10).
test_conditions: Generalization: trained on Region 1 with 8 UEs, tested on unseen Regions 2 and 3 (other BSs) with 4 to 32 UEs; otherwise Region 1 hold-out (pp. 9-13).
baselines: Non-learned: uncoordinated and coordinated beam selection [25]; optimized hybrid beamforming with perfect or compressed-sensing mmWave CSI. Learned: only own CNN G(.) plus heuristic selection (pp. 10-13).
metrics: Sum spectrum efficiency (bit/s/Hz), NMSE of beamspace prediction, pilot count, order of complexity, measured speed-up (Figs. 9-13, p. 14).
complexity: Overall O((K^2*T+K*T_G)*Nz*Nw+N_RF^3) versus O(K*Nz*Nw+N_RF^3) for heuristics; measured 5 times faster than the uncoordinated method with 12 UEs (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 9: "to evaluate the proposed SA-MUHBF based on the DeepMIMO dataset [33], [34]"; the O1 ray-tracing scenario at 3.5 and 28 GHz is used for training and testing (Table I, Fig. 7).
q2_support: p. 13: "for the generalization test, SA-MUHBF is trained for the 8 UEs setup in Region 1" and tested on Regions 2 and 3 (Fig. 12, "unseen regions", other BSs, 4 to 32 UEs).
q3_support: p. 10: "we also consider the integration of mmWave" beamspace prediction network G with the two heuristic baselines of [25]; the only learned comparisons are the proposed CNN plus heuristics (ablations of the GNN). GNN works [31], [37] are discussed on p. 8 but not compared.
q4_support: p. 14: "the overall complexity of SA-MUHBF is on the order of" O((K^2 T + K T_G) Nz Nw + N_RF^3); the same section reports a measured speed-up of 5 times over the uncoordinated method with 12 UEs.
q5_support: p. 9: "to evaluate the proposed SA-MUHBF based on the DeepMIMO dataset [33], [34]"; trains and tests on the public DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset. The authors release no code of their own.
notes: Two learned functions: CNN beamspace prediction (area 2) and GNN analog beam selection (area 3). Area 3 is chosen because the main metric is the sum spectrum efficiency (abstract, Eq. 6) and the title is hybrid beamforming. q3 is 0 because G+uncoordinated and G+coordinated reuse the proposed CNN with heuristic selection, which are ablations, and no earlier learned beam-selection or GNN method is compared in Figs. 9-13. q2 rests on the SA-MUHBF-8-R1 test on unseen Regions 2 and 3; the text names BS 15 for Region 3 while the Fig. 12 caption says BS 16.
